lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like array of high-luminance circular blobs arranged in roughly 5-6 discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, with 3-4 visible rows.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting major blobs, most visible in the mid-flank region where blobs serve as nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal ridges visible on the lateral flank, exhibiting high-intensity upper edges and shadowed lower boundaries, running parallel to the body axis.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Dorsal fin macro-mask contains approximately 10-12 discrete, low-diameter high-luminance blobs distributed irregularly across the visible surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/notch on the posterior edge of the right pectoral fin; irregular pale depigmentation patch on the upper flank ventral to the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Transition from high-density, small-diameter punctate patterns on the cephalic and branchial regions to lower-density, larger-diameter blobs on the lateral trunk.
